import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap, cost;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static class Node implements Comparable<Node> {
        int dist, hop, node;
        Node(int dist, int hop, int node) {
            this.dist = dist;
            this.hop = hop;
            this.node = node;
        }
        public int compareTo(Node other) {
            if (this.dist != other.dist) return Integer.compare(this.dist, other.dist);
            return Integer.compare(this.hop, other.hop);
        }
    }

    static final int INF = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> adj;
    static ArrayList<Edge> edges;
    static int[] dist, hop, prevEdge;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        int idx = edges.size();
        edges.add(new Edge(v, idx + 1, cap, cost));
        edges.add(new Edge(u, idx, 0, -cost));
        adj.get(u).add(idx);
        adj.get(v).add(idx + 1);
    }

    static void dijkstra(int s) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(hop, INF);
        dist[s] = 0;
        hop[s] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Node> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();
        pq.add(new Node(0, 0, s));
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            Node cur = pq.poll();
            int u = cur.node;
            int d = cur.dist;
            int h = cur.hop;
            if (d != dist[u] || h != hop[u]) continue;
            for (int ei : adj.get(u)) {
                Edge e = edges.get(ei);
                if (e.cap == 0) continue;
                int v = e.to;
                int nd = dist[u] + e.cost;
                int nh = hop[u] + 1;
                if (nd < dist[v] || (nd == dist[v] && nh < hop[v])) {
                    dist[v] = nd;
                    hop[v] = nh;
                    prevEdge[v] = ei;
                    pq.add(new Node(nd, nh, v));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void push(int s, int t) {
        int u = t;
        while (u != s) {
            int ei = prevEdge[u];
            Edge e = edges.get(ei);
            e.cap--;
            edges.get(e.rev).cap++;
            u = edges.get(e.rev).to; // reverse edge's to is the original u
        }
    }

    static int minCostFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flowCost = 0;
        int[] origCost = new int[edges.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
            origCost[i] = edges.get(i).cost;
        }

        while (true) {
            dijkstra(s);
            if (dist[t] == INF) break;
            push(s, t);
            for (int u = 0; u < adj.size(); u++) {
                if (dist[u] == INF) continue;
                for (int ei : adj.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = edges.get(ei);
                    if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] != INF) {
                        e.cost += dist[u] - dist[e.to];
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int ei = 0; ei < edges.size(); ei++) {
            if (ei % 2 == 1) { // back edge
                flowCost += origCost[ei] * edges.get(ei).cap;
            }
        }
        return flowCost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] start = new int[k];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            start[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
        }

        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> baseAdj = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) baseAdj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            baseAdj.get(a).add(b);
            baseAdj.get(b).add(a);
        }

        int t = n + k + 1;
        int N_total = n * t + 1;
        adj = new ArrayList<>(N_total);
        for (int i = 0; i < N_total; i++) adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
        edges = new ArrayList<>();
        dist = new int[N_total];
        hop = new int[N_total];
        prevEdge = new int[N_total];

        // Movement edges
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s;
                for (int j : baseAdj.get(i)) {
                    int v = j * t + s + 1;
                    for (int x = 1; x <= k; x++) {
                        addEdge(u, v, 1, c + (x * 2 - 1) * d);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Stay edges
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int s = 0; s < t - 1; s++) {
                int u = i * t + s, v = u + 1;
                int stayCost = (i == 0 ? 0 : c);
                addEdge(u, v, k, stayCost);
            }
        }

        // Source to start positions
        int source = N_total - 1;
        for (int h = 0; h < k; h++) {
            addEdge(source, start[h] * t + 0, 1, 0);
        }

        int sink = 0 * t + t - 1;
        int result = minCostFlow(source, sink);
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
